Two girls, one at the cash register and another one visiting her, started laughing and ridiculing me and refused to sell supplements after they claimed that "they in Malta have all necessary vitamins/microelements in the drinking water". Prosit.

en.text:
Good morning  there might have been a huge misunderstanding which might have been due to language barrier. Firstly, ridiculing clients is completely unacceptable and definitely not done by our team and lastly, we would never recommend drinking local tap water, let alone promote it when we sell all supplements clients might need.
Nonetheless I apologize for seeing this now and the misunderstanding which was caused

J’ai tenté de chercher les caméras dans cette pharmacie. Malheureusement ce n’était pas une blague.
La pharmacienne est très désagréable et souffle à plusieurs reprises pendant qu’on lui parle (la barrière de la langue français-anglais combinée aux termes médicaux s’avère difficile même avec un niveau moyen en anglais)
Elle est même partie pour chuchoter quelque chose à sa collègue et se faire remplacer.
Vous pouvez changer de métier madame, vous n’avez rien d’une pharmacienne. Même la vente ne voudrait pas de vous.
Et encore, je pèse mes mots.

en.text:
Good morning and apologies for seeing this now. Our premises have cctv all around. Main one right on top of the counter. You might have been welcomed by one of our sales team thus the reason why she moved you to another colleague - the actual pharmacist.
Unfortunately we encounter a lot of problems due to language barrier which you admitted yourself in explaining your query and our staff might have had the same in understanding your request and serving you in the best way possible.
Nonetheless we apologize for the late reply and misunderstanding

Selbst mein Lieblingsnasenspray gibt es hier.

review_text.en:
Went looking for a drug which they didn't have. They offered me an alternative I purchased. The box I was given was already open, but since the blisters were all there I took it.
Once at the office I searched the name of the drug on google, not for my condition.
I went for a return, first they disputed the fact they gave me the box already open and then they told me that anyway they don't accept returns. Very strange and unprofessional (apart from the return policy joke, I was given a drug with the opposite effect of the one I had asked!)

en.text: Hi sir. Unfortunately as already discussed in person it is not legal for us to accept any medication as returns. This is the law as set by the Maltese Authorities. Also to note, and as advised in person the medication we supplied to you was indeed correct and the box, as is our legal requirement was sold as sealed, and not in the opened and torn condition it was brought back in. I hope this addresses your concerns on our inability to accept the product return.

review_text.en:
I had a great experience at this pharmacy. The staff were incredibly friendly, professional, and always willing to take the time to answer my questions in detail. They made me feel comfortable and well taken care of, which is something I truly value when it comes to healthcare services.

The pharmacy itself was clean, well-organized, and efficiently run. My prescription was prepared quickly, and the pharmacist took the time to explain how to use the medication properly and what to expect. I also appreciated their helpful advice on over-the-counter products.

Overall, the service was reliable, caring, and efficient. I would definitely recommend this pharmacy to anyone looking for knowledgeable staff and excellent customer care.

review_text.en:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Absolutely love this place. Not just a pharmacy, it’s a full health and beauty destination all in one. From supplements and skincare to perfumes and medical services, they genuinely have everything you need under one roof.  ￼

The team is always so helpful and knowledgeable, you can really feel the care and professionalism every time you visit. It’s also super convenient with such a wide range of products, from everyday essentials to more advanced wellness and beauty treatments.  ￼

Highly recommend if you’re looking for quality, variety, and a place that actually understands your needs 🤍
